name: manual_007d21
claim: After an ambiguous peer send, check the authenticated destination listing and content before retrying; skip delivered or superseded queue records, reconcile destination ownership item by item, and do not confuse shared-inbox acceptance with acknowledgement from every active agent.

decisions.notes: Codex reviewer reconciled six terminal outbox deliveries plus one directly accepted acknowledgement request against Windows seven-file arrival report on 2026-11-04. Other-node and unspecified-destination records were preserved rather than silently redirected.
